notes: Every enemy ship page (Category:Enemies = pages using Template:Enemy, minus the 'Enemies' overview) plus the 10 scripted phases of the Finale page. category/area/zone come from Template:Enemies nav (the wiki's own, post-1.1 list); encounter refines category (common/elite/boss/alternate_boss/event/repair_yard/finale). Enemies have no decks: every part shows an intent; a 'move' = one turn's full set of part intents, in the order the wiki lists them. moves[].effect is the wiki text ('Attack 2 from left cannon' = that part fires straight down its lane); moves[].movement is how the ship repositions BEFORE acting ('Move any number of spaces / Aims at player' = lines its firing parts up with the player's ship); intent is a '+'-joined tag list derived by regex (attack/shield/missile/drone/card/debuff/buff/heal/move/none). pattern = the wiki's sentence on how actions are chosen. hull/shield = max values on Normal (hull_hardest/shield_hardest when the wiki gives one; *_text keeps the raw infobox). parts = Layout list (left->right) when the page has one, the parts that intents come from, and trait sentences (Weak/Brittle/Armored/Concussable/Empty). passives = infobox 'Starts with', fight modifiers/rules and environment notes. hardest = every sentence mentioning Hardest. Stub pages (wiki_stub=true) only have stats; their patch_notes are filled from Patch pages. Numbers on intents do not include accumulated Powerdrive/Overdrive.

enemies.name: Crystalline Entity
parts: Width: 12 tiles

moves.effect: The boss's total damage output starts at 4, and increases by 1 each turn with no limit.
This means that on turn 1, it could do four 1 damage attacks, one big 4 damage attack, or anything in between, all from randomly picked cannons.

enemies.pattern: The Crystalline Entity's attacks are wildly unpredictable, as it can attack from any of its parts (except the empty ones). Its damage output starts low, but gradually increases over the course of the fight. The boss's total damage output starts at 4, and increases by 1 each turn with no limit. This damage is spread out randomly across all of its cannons. This means that on turn 1, it could do four 1 damage attacks, one big 4 damage attack, or anything in between, all from randomly picked cannons. Note that cannons won't do multishots; all of the damage assigned to a single cannon is released in one attack. On Hardest, there are less cannons for the Crystalline Entity to attack from, so the average damage of each cannon tends to be higher.
enemies.movement: The Crystalline Entity never moves, unless you are too far away from it. Specifically, if you have 4 or more (Hardest: 3 or more) ship parts that are not facing any of its parts, then it will move towards you to catch up. The amount of spaces it moves depends solely on how many turns have passed, no matter how many spaces away you are. On turns 1-3 it will move one space towards you to catch up. Starting on turn 4, it will move two spaces. On every 5th turn afterwards (9, 14, 19..), the amount of spaces it will move to catch up increases by 1. This amount is capped at 12 spaces (the length of the "ship"), which is reached on turn 54.
hardest: It is a large mass of crystals with 30 hull (Hardest: 34 hull) and no shields.
On Hardest difficulty, three random parts are replaced with empty parts, which appear visually as clusters of tiny crystals.
On Hardest, there are less cannons for the Crystalline Entity to attack from, so the average damage of each cannon tends to be higher.
Specifically, if you have 4 or more (Hardest: 3 or more) ship parts that are not facing any of its parts, then it will move towards you to catch up.
Crystalline Entity now shuffles all of its parts at the start of each turn on Hardest difficulty.
enemies.description: Big crystal.
enemies.summary: Crystalline Entity is the boss of Zone 1. It is a large mass of crystals with 30 hull (Hardest: 34 hull) and no shields. It is also referred to simply as "big crystal".
patch_notes: [Patch 1.0.7 (2024-05-15)] Crystalline Entity now shuffles all of its parts at the start of each turn on Hardest difficulty. (undocumented change)

Rules: Your objective is to score a Football into the enemy goal (blue), which is on the left of the field. You will lose if it gets scored into your goal (red), which is on the right. A goal is scored when a Football moves on or through it. The goals are indestructible and cannot be moved with Droneshift. A Football starts in the center of the field, 9 spaces away from each goal. It moves left when you shoot it--or to the right when the enemy shoots it--by a number of spaces equal to the damage it was hit with. You can also launch a midrow object at it to move it 2 spaces left (or 3 spaces with a Heavy Missile). Thanks to the excitement of sports, you start the fight with 1 Ace.

Penalty System: If you hit the enemy ship with an attack, Sasha will give you a Yellow Card as a penalty which temporarily clogs your deck. Get three penalties and you're kicked out of the match, with no rewards whatsoever. You only get a penalty when you hit the enemy. Triggering their Autododge and missing (even with Grazer Beam) is okay, and so are indirect sources of damage like Corrosion. Additionally, if you land multiple hits using a single card, you won't get multiple penalties, just one. If you manage to destroy the enemy ship without getting 3 penalties, you will win the match, even if the finishing blow would give you a third penalty. You can still pick a prize as normal.
